sn3.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena pañcannaṃ rājūnaṃ Pasenadipamukhānaṃ pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappitānaṃ samaṅgibhūtānaṃ paricārayamānānaṃ ayam antarā kathā udapādi || ||
sn3.12:1.14: Yato kho te rājāno nāsakkhiṃsu aññaṃ aññaṃ saññāpetuṃ || || 4.
sn3.12:2.1: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo te rājāno etad avoca || ||
sn3.12:2.2: Āyāma mārisā || yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamissāma || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etam atthaṃ paṭipucchissāma ||
sn3.12:2.3: Yathā no Bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāreyyāmā ti || || 5.
sn3.12:2.4: Evam marisā ti kho te rājāno rañño Pasenadi-kosalassa paccassosuṃ || || 6.
sn3.12:3.1: Atha kho te pañca rājāno Pasenadi-pamukhā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 7. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.12:3.2: Idha bhante amhākaṃ pañcannam rājūnaṃ pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitānaṃ samaṅgibhūtānaṃ paricārayamānaṃ ayam antarā kathā udapādi || ||
sn3.12:3.6: Ekacce evam ahaṃsu || rūpā kāmānam aggan ti || || Ekacce evam ahaṃsu ||
sn3.12:3.14: Kin-nu kho bhante kāmānam aggan ti || || 8.
sn3.12:4.1: Manāpa-pariyantam khvāhaṃ mahārāja pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aggan ti vadāmi ||
sn3.12:4.2: Te ca mahārāja rūpā ekaccassa manāpā honti te ca rūpā ekaccassa amanāpā honti ||
sn3.12:4.3: Yehi ca yo rūpehi attamano hoti paripuṇṇa-saṅkappo so tehi rūpehi aññaṃ rūpam uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti ||
sn3.12:5.1: Te ca mahārāja saddā || pe || Te
sn3.12:8.1: mahārāja poṭṭhabbā ekaccassa manāpā honti || Te ca poṭṭhabbā ekaccassa amanāpā honti ||
sn3.12:8.2: Yehi ca yo poṭṭhabbehi attamano hoti paripuṇṇa-saṅkappo || so tehi poṭṭhabbehi aññaṃ poṭṭhabbam uttaritaraṃ vā panītataram vā na pattheti ||
sn3.12:9.1: Tena kho pana samayena Candanaṅgaliko upāsako tassam parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti ||
sn3.12:9.2: Atha kho Candanaṅgaliko upāsako uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten-añjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.12:9.3: Paṭibhāti mam Bhagavā patibhāti maṃ Sugatāti || || 11.
sn3.12:10.1: Atha kho Candanaṅgaliko upāsako Bhagavato sammukhā tad-anurūpāyā gāthāya abhitthavi || ||
sn3.12:12.1: Atha kho te pañcarājāno Candanaṅgalikam upāsakam pañcahi saṅgehi acchādesuṃ || || 14.
sn3.12:12.2: Atha kho Candanaṅgaliko upāsako tehi pañcahi uttarāsaṅgehi Bhagavantam acchādesīti || || 1. Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || ||
